_readme: This file is the single source of truth for card benefits. Run `npm run seed:build` after editing.
Every amount is null until you verify it on the issuer site. Null amounts count as $0 in all totals.
When you verify a benefit: set amount (per period), status = "active", last_verified = "YYYY-MM-DD", and source_url to the exact page you checked.
period: monthly | quarterly | semiannual | annual | per_claim. period_anchor: calendar | cardmember_year (resets on the card open date).
amount_schedule (monthly credits only): {"12": 35} overrides the amount for December.
country / currency: where the card is issued and the currency of its fees and credits. A benefit can override currency (e.g. US$ coverage on a TT$ card).
fee_note: free-text reminder about the annual fee while it is unverified.
